plainLanguage: Section 75 inafanya participation katika unlawful assembly kuwa offence na inaweka imprisonment ya mwaka mmoja.
meaning: Liability depends on taking part in an assembly that satisfies the statutory definition in section 74; section 75 should therefore be read with section 74.
keyPoints: The person must take part in an unlawful assembly.
Section 74 supplies the definition of unlawful assembly.
The stated penalty is imprisonment for one year.

history.summary: Section 075 is recorded in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Official R.E. 2022 text verified before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The statutory definition should be applied element by element rather than from the label alone.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The nature of the gathering, common purpose, conduct and statutory threshold must be assessed from evidence and context.
